body: ac-00: re-baseline 4 numeric clusters' FP rate on shipped default v19 (utc/url/boolean->integer, integer->decimal); drop any already ~0 on v19
All four clusters survive re-baseline on v19 (utc 0.837, bool 0.993, url 1.000, int->dec 1.000). None drop. See output/v24-numeric-precision/rebaseline_v19.md

78,612 hard negatives, all 4 clusters non-zero, zero categorical asserted, MADR 0056 dedup 56 dropped. output/v24-numeric-precision/hard_negatives.parquet
ac-02 DONE-partial: v19 Sense-dist baseline + blend audit PASSED (251,270 rows, 0 categorical). REMAINS: FTMB-level audit (VALID_DIM=240/cap/per-type) — coupled to cap decision below
ac-03 BLOCKED on cap decision: spec says cap<=600 (ac-02) vs ~1200 (ac-03); v23 used 1800. Pick before FTMB prepare + train 3 seeds

Cap RESOLVED: 1800 (author decision 2026-06-03 'match v23, use cap 1800 and train'). Keeps v24 a clean data-composition delta over v23. Script scripts/overnight_v24_numeric.sh launched in tmux session v24-retrain: 3 seeds (42/43/44), 50 epochs, patience 15, NO --include-column-level-types.
